shapeSummary: Right-angle-free offset gearmotor: white plastic gearbox block (12 x 34 x 10 mm, rounded top) with a 3 mm D-shaft (9.7 mm long) along Z at the top. A 10 x 10 mm motor body extends along Z from the gearbox bottom, ending in a thin encoder PCB with a small side connector block and a round black disc (magnet/sensor). Two small blind holes in the gearbox face.
